summary: The change does what the request asked: a design document only, with no code. docs/design/hestia.md has an eight-row table. Each row gives the check, whether it is code or a model, how often it runs, and whether Hestia fixes it or reports it. The disk filling up on 2026-10-23 is cited in the cache row. The document also covers the budget with a stop rule (every figure labelled an estimate), how findings are measured, the rule that an empty findings list counts as success only with the list of checks that ran, how Hades's cleanup is folded in and when it splits out, seven alternatives, the boundary with Artemis taken from D127 (Hestia does not gate work), and a ten-job build plan with the deterministic checks first. D129 is added after D128 as a proposed top-level entry with the same fields as its neighbours. A CHANGELOG bullet and a one-line pointer in the roadmap were added. I checked that the citations resolve: BRIEF.md lines 603–607 and 1060–1061, scope-guard.md lines 35 and 219, D127 alternative (b), job-planning.md section 9, and the test system_facts_budgets_match_computed. Athena's recorded cargo test passed. The recorded fmt check was skipped as docs-only, so I ran `cargo fmt --all --check` myself and it passed. The one minor issue: the queue row says the request cites 49 open requests, but neither the request nor BRIEF.md contains that number.
